alternate_names: Sri Sahasra Lingeswara Swamy and Sri Veera Anjaneya Swamy Devasthanam

history.summary: CSV town 'Guntur' is approximate - actual town is Ponnur (~29 km south of Guntur). Built in 1969 by Kota Jagannadha (Jaganatha) Swamy, who installed the Anjaneya and Garuda statues. The 24-ft tall, 12-ft wide, 4-ft thick Hanuman was carved from a single black-granite rock brought from Edlapadu near Chilakaluripet under the supervision of Bhavanarayana Swamy. The complex also holds a 30-ft tall Garuda shrine and the Sahasra Lingeswara shrine with five Shiva lingas at the feet of the Lord, worshipped daily with sandalwood removed only once a year.

name: Sri Anjaneya Swamy Temple, Ponnur
town_description: Ponnur is a town in Guntur district, Andhra Pradesh, on the Guntur-Chirala state highway about 29 km south of Guntur. It is a regional pilgrimage centre known for its Hanuman temple and the Sahasra Lingeswara shrines, and serves as a market town for the surrounding agricultural villages.
tradition: Vaishnavism (Hanuman), with Shaiva shrines in the complex

travel.road: On the Guntur-Chirala state highway (SH 40), ~29 km south of Guntur; well connected by bus to Guntur, Tenali and Bapatla

visitor_information.best_time: October-February; Hanuman Jayanthi (4 days) draws the largest crowds
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM-8:00 PM per gotirupati.com; pujasthan.com and Justdial list 5:00 AM-8:00/9:00 PM - verify on arrival
